collapse_trap_note: 20 (satellite, leg) pairs whose rendered discriminator is ONE value across every view and row that carries it. The previous profile listed 10; all 10 are inside this 20. The extra 10 are legs derived from a source COLUMN that happens to be constant because only one view carries the leg - a weaker signal than a literal constant, but the consequence is the same: the leg cannot separate the instances it is the discriminator for. IDENTICAL at the baseline snapshot, so this is a detector widening, not a bundle change. The spec builder must assert no key expression references any of the 20.
renumbering_ordinal_note: Seven spellings, re-enumerated from 00_tables_index.json this run by shape, not by lookup. ZERO reach a resolved_key expression. SERIAL_NO reaches 11 child-key legs, all on SAT_POLICY_DOCUMENT_DISPATCH.'Dispatch Serial Number' - which is ALSO one of the 20 collapse traps, so it is doubly disqualified as a child-key leg. Identical at the baseline snapshot.

ordinal_shaped_names_not_classified_as_o.BILL_NO: reaches 29 child-key legs as 'Bill Number'. Classified NOT an ordinal: an invoice/bill number is a document identifier, not a per-parent sequence. UNPROVEN - there is no sample data in this run.
ordinal_shaped_names_not_classified_as_o.TRIP_NO: reaches 12 HUB_RISK_OBJECT key rows as the FALLBACK operand of "'TRIP:' || coalesce(nullif(trim(PNR),''), nullif(trim(TRIP_NO),''))". If TRIP_NO is a per-policy ordinal rather than a global trip identifier, every policy's first trip keys to 'TRIP:1' and the hub merges unrelated trips. UNPROVEN - no sample data. See open item TRIPNO-FALLBACK.

layer_sizing.note: 51 of the 113 casts are for views that are NEVER a row table_name - 45 percent of the cast surface exists for views nothing maps. 36 of those exist only because a hop skips a level. Byte-identical to the baseline snapshot under the same measurement.

bespoke_layers.name: augmented-track alignment shim
bespoke_layers.reason: OPUS travel_dv_dbt already builds 12 SAT_AUG_* satellites. 94 augmentation rows land on 9 concepts OPUS already augments, so they must be emitted INTO the OPUS-named SAT_AUG_<X> with OPUS's src_pk, single-active grain and bare HASHDIFF, extending its payload, rather than into a Maximus-side second satellite. The standard augmented layer builds per-map and cannot express that; declared exception under BUILD_RULES.md 6.5, required by 7.7.

bespoke_layers.name: EAV instance fan-out driven by a literal leg
bespoke_layers.reason: 593 child-key legs are pure literals naming a column-as-instance inside a pivot view. The unpivot layer must fan one parent row into N instance rows keyed by the LEG LITERAL, which has no source column to unpivot from - the literal IS the instance name. 39 of these legs carry no 'expression' field at all and the generator must synthesise the quoted literal from 'value'.

name_injectivity_note: Re-proved this run: the 44-entry abbreviation vocabulary applied to all 113 views needing a cast yields 113 distinct names, 0 collisions, longest 41 characters against a 63-character Snowflake identifier budget, from a longest source view name of 138. The previous profile reported 36; the difference is my application order, not the view set, which is identical.

child_key_leg_hazards.synthesis_rule: For the 44 literal legs the generator must synthesise a quoted SQL literal from `value`; there is no expression to copy.

PROSE_PLACEHOLDER_IN_A_VALUE_FIELD.value: '<not on this view - no media / document identifier on this view>'
PROSE_PLACEHOLDER_IN_A_VALUE_FIELD.why: The ONE leg whose leg_backing is `unresolved` carries no expression and a `value` that is an ALREADY-QUOTED English sentence. A generator that synthesises a literal from `value` - which is the correct rule for the other 44 - writes that sentence into the child key. It must be refused at build time as a sentinel, not rendered. This leg is also one of the 20 collapse traps.

build_directives.directive_note: A key that resolves to nothing must be REJECTED at build time - never fall through to a bare FOREIGN_KEY operand, never mint a namespace prefix with an empty suffix.
build_directives.mechanism: In the wide stage wrap every hub and link key as: case when <expr> is null or trim(<expr>) = '' then null else <expr> end. Do NOT add a comparison against the CSV's degenerate constant - under Snowflake semantics the expression is NULL, not that constant, so such a predicate can never fire. Emit a per-hub rejected-row count into build_artifacts (BUILD_RULES.md 9.5).

build_directives.directive_note: The separator-degeneration guard is ALREADY IN THE MAP on all 185 degenerating concats and it fires. The build must copy it through and must not add a second one.
build_directives.mechanism: Emit resolved_key.expression and child_key_components[].expression verbatim. Assert as a gate that every concat which evaluates to a non-empty constant on an all-blank row is enclosed by a nullif whose second operand equals that constant - the same probe used here, reusable as a build-side check.

build_directives.directive_note: Do NOT normalise either hash-operand guard idiom. Both are correct in context and the mapper has asked twice that they be left alone.
build_directives.mechanism: Copy content-hash expressions through unchanged; add NO coalesce-placement rewrite rule anywhere in the generator chain.

build_directives.directive_note: normalise(x) = collapse_internal_whitespace(upper(trim(x))), NULL in NULL out, applied to the whole concatenation and NOT per component. It KEEPS the empty slot rather than dropping nulls before concat.
build_directives.mechanism: One function in mtv2_keyrules.py emitting upper + trim + regexp_replace(x,'\\s+',' '). Never substitute a hash whose NULL handling differs. Implement md5(NULL) -> NULL explicitly rather than relying on the warehouse.

build_directives.directive_note: A second, undeclared canonicalisation exists on the 'NOMINEE:' party keys. upper+trim does not collapse internal whitespace, so it is NOT the same key space as normalise.
build_directives.mechanism: Emit those 10 verbatim as mapped - changing them would re-key a hub on my own authority - and raise the divergence to the mapper. Record the two canonicalisations in BUILD_STATUS.json so the split is visible.

build_directives.directive_note: Resolve an abbreviated spine destination ONLY against the start view's own ancestor chain, longest matching prefix wins; if a token still matches more than one ancestor, STOP.
build_directives.mechanism: The resolver takes the start view, walks parent_table_candidate from 00_tables_index.json and matches suffixes on that chain only. Verified here to resolve all 297 abbreviated hops with 0 ambiguity and 0 misses.

build_directives.directive_note: The spine operator is an LCA cross, not a climb. 2 arrows reach a sibling.
build_directives.mechanism: Resolve every hop as lowest-common-ancestor; a climb-only resolver silently returns nothing for PREMIUM_DETAILS -> POLICY_DETAILS and the miss reads as a source gap.

build_directives.directive_note: 787 of 5496 arrows skip 1 to 4 levels; every intervening view must be expanded into the join chain.
build_directives.mechanism: Expand each hop through the parent chain before emitting joins. This is what makes 14 of the 51 walk-only casts necessary; sizing the cast layer from named destinations alone under-builds it.

build_directives.directive_note: A link leg must be byte-identical to the key of the hub it references; a disagreeing leg produces an empty join, which reads as sparse source data rather than an error.
build_directives.mechanism: 25 of 51 LNK call sites are POSITIONAL and 11 have a single leg, so leg identity CANNOT be recovered from a name on those. Match each leg's expression STRING against the set of hub key expressions resolved on the same view (BUILD_RULES.md 4). Assert every LNK leg string appears verbatim as some hub's resolved_key.expression on that view; raise on any that does not.

build_directives.directive_note: Build HUB_RISK_OBJECT in the QUALIFIED <root>#POL_RISK_ID form and expect TWO namespaces ('RISK:' 215 rows, 'TRIP:' 12) until the source answers. Unchanged by this re-issue - verified identical old and new.
build_directives.mechanism: Isolate the '#' qualifier in ONE function so a source answer drops it across all 210 rows in a single edit. Count rows per namespace prefix into BUILD_STATUS.json.

build_directives.directive_note: Do NOT collapse SAT_POLICY_DOCUMENT_DISPATCH (11 rows) into SAT_POLICY_DELIVERY.
build_directives.mechanism: Build them as two satellites. SAT_POLICY_DELIVERY is single-active SCD2 on HUB_POLICY; the dispatch source is a depth-2 shred child and all 11 rows declare multi_active with child key 'Dispatch Serial Number'.

build_directives.directive_note: The mapper declares the SERIAL_NO child key a positional ordinal and a source gap, but did NOT re-key it. The build receives an unstable child-key leg.
build_directives.mechanism: Build the 11 rows as mapped, and emit the declaration into BUILD_STATUS.json as a known-unstable child key. Do NOT silently substitute POD_NUMBER - the mapper named it a candidate, not a decision (BUILD_RULES.md 5.7).

build_directives.directive_note: 39 augmentation rows declare a compound child key and supply only some of its legs - e.g. SAT_POLICY_PREMIUM_HEAD declares 4 legs and 5 rows supply 1. Rows sharing the supplied legs collide on the missing ones.
build_directives.mechanism: Do not invent the missing legs. Within one satellite the child key must be ONE leg set; SAT_POLICY_PREMIUM_HEAD currently carries three different sets across its rows. Build only the rows that supply the satellite's full declared set and list the rest in accepted_uncovered.txt with the mapper's own 'declared, NOT invented' wording.

build_directives.directive_note: 2 rows on SAT_CLAIM_EVIDENCE carry a child_key_value that names no leg while the satellite declares 2 legs; the mapper refused to guess the pairing.
build_directives.mechanism: Leave both unbuilt; accepted_uncovered with the mapper's reason.

build_directives.bundle_item: STAGE-0 finding on the 281 emitted components
build_directives.directive_note: Augmentation multi-active rows with a rendering-only child key fell 283 -> 2. Nothing in the build may parse child_key_value prose.
build_directives.mechanism: Read child_key_components[] only. If a generator branch exists that parses child_key_value, delete it - it now has 2 live inputs and both are declared gaps.

build_directives.directive_note: Seven source column names begin with a digit (1ST_REMINDER_DATE, 2ND_REMINDER_DATE, 3RD_REMINDER_DATE, 64_VB_STATUS).
build_directives.mechanism: Double-quote every source column identifier in emitted SQL. An unquoted 1ST_REMINDER_DATE is a Snowflake syntax error that the static gates will not catch because dbt is out of scope.

build_directives.directive_note: OPUS's contract on its 12 SAT_AUG_* satellites is absolute: single-active, no child key, bare HASHDIFF, src_pk a HUB key - including the two LNK_-named ones, which key on PARTY_HKEY, not a link key.
build_directives.mechanism: Emit the 94 same-concept rows into the OPUS-named SAT_AUG_<X> under OPUS's contract. The 16 SAT_PARTY_BANKING rows that declare multi-active CANNOT be honoured as multi-active without breaking that contract - build them single-active and raise the grain divergence (see open item AUG-GRAIN-BANKING).

build_directives.directive_note: The CSV is the agreed diff target for key degeneration, but it renders 899 of 2344 rows differently from the map and omits the 22 key-less rows.
build_directives.mechanism: Diff after normalisation: strip one layer of single quotes from the map value, map the map's NULL prose onto the CSV's empty-cell + NULL verdict. Re-derive nothing else from it. Treat the map's 2366 resolved_key blocks - not the CSV's 2344 rows - as the key inventory.

build_directives.directive_note: The single leg_backing='unresolved' leg carries a quoted prose sentinel in `value` and no expression.
build_directives.mechanism: Treat leg_backing=unresolved as a HARD SENTINEL: refuse the row at build time and report it as an unbuilt item, never synthesise a literal from its `value`.

build_directives.directive_note: The field now holds an English sentence on all 2344 rows.
build_directives.mechanism: Derive the guard operand from the expression AST (the second argument of the applied nullif); never read degenerate_value.

build_directives.directive_note: 297 abbreviated spine destinations, of which PARTY_PROPERTY (145 hops) matches two tables globally.
build_directives.mechanism: Resolve an abbreviated destination ONLY against the start view's own ancestor chain, longest matching prefix. Verified to resolve all 297 uniquely; resolved globally, 67 hops cross from the proposer branch into the member branch.

build_directives.directive_note: A link leg must equal the key of the hub it references.
build_directives.mechanism: Emit the hub key expression for the leg by construction, so the two cannot diverge. 7 value-changing divergences exist in the map today.

open_items.summary_note: On a *_PIVOT_VW, does PARENT_KEY_HASH join to the view's own base node or to that node's parent? The pack scopes this as 11 (view, join column, returned column) groups over 872 expression slots and calls it a round-2 blocker. Grouped by the physical fact actually in question - (view, join column) - it is 8 groups over 1076 slots, and 1464 spine slots in total use PARENT_KEY_HASH from a pivot view. 697 arrows currently name the view's own base node as the first destination.
open_items.proposed_default: Build the DOMINANT walk per (view, join column) - the variant with more uses - and emit a per-group diagnostic counting rows reached by each variant, so a source answer can be applied in one pass. Not blocking: every affected expression is a spine walk, re-runnable, and no model or satellite placement depends on the answer. It IS the largest single correctness risk in the bundle: the loser mints a second population in HUB_RISK_OBJECT / HUB_PARTY / HUB_POLICY.

open_items.summary_note: KEY_DEGENERATE_VALUES.csv and the map's inline degenerate_value agree on identity (same 2344 keys, byte-identical expressions) but disagree in rendering on 899 rows, and the CSV is internally inconsistent: it SQL-quotes the empty class ('') and leaves the constant class unquoted (RISK:). Under ANSI/Snowflake semantics all 2344 expressions evaluate to NULL on an all-blank row, so the 369 'NON-EMPTY CONSTANT' verdicts and the 1445 'empty' verdicts are both wrong as values, though safe as instructions.
open_items.proposed_default: Diff after normalising; reject on NULL-or-empty, never on equality with the stated constant. Ask the mapper to (a) render both classes the same way, (b) state which evaluator produced the values, and (c) include the 22 key-less rows.

open_items.summary_note: 16 augmentation rows propose SAT_PARTY_BANKING multi-active on child key 'Account Number Masked'. OPUS builds SAT_AUG_PARTY_BANKING single-active on PARTY_HKEY with no child key. 14 of the 16 back the leg with a real column; 2 back it with the literal 'BG_HOLDER_REFUND', which discriminates nothing. This is a GRAIN divergence, not a naming one.
open_items.proposed_default: Build under OPUS's single-active contract and report the 14 genuinely multi-valued rows in the handback. Reversing later costs a re-run; diverging now costs a second satellite for one concept across two LOBs.

open_items.summary_note: 08_decisions.json states '8 EXACT attribute collisions and 90 same-concept rows'. Against the OPUS BUILD I measure 94 same-concept rows and 2 exact collisions (both 'Employee Number' on SAT_PARTY_EMPLOYMENT); widening to all 45 OPUS as-built satellites gives 240. The 8 is not reproducible under either scoping.
open_items.proposed_default: Use 94 and 2. Ask the mapper for the scoping behind the 8 - if it was a third population, it may name concepts neither count covers.

open_items.summary_note: 128 content hashes use md5(normalise(...)); 10 use md5(upper(trim(...))), which does not collapse internal whitespace. KEY_FUNCTIONS.md defines only the first. The 10 key HUB_PARTY / LNK_PARTY_ROLE through the 'NOMINEE:' namespace.
open_items.proposed_default: Emit as mapped and raise. Do not unify on my own authority - unifying re-keys a hub.

open_items.summary_note: HUB_LOCATION is hashed in 9 distinct (separator, operand-count) shapes and LNK_PARTY_LOCATION in 4, with three separators (| # and space) and 3 to 8 operands, each view in its own column order. Health and Partner use a fixed eight-slot order with one separator, so one physical address keys differently per view AND per LOB.
open_items.proposed_default: Build as mapped - re-canonicalising is a cross-LOB decision, not a build one - and emit the shape census into BUILD_STATUS.json so the divergence is visible before anyone joins on it.

open_items.summary_note: 12 HUB_RISK_OBJECT rows key "'TRIP:' || coalesce(nullif(trim(PNR),''), nullif(trim(TRIP_NO),''))". If TRIP_NO is a per-policy ordinal rather than a global trip identifier, every policy's first trip collapses onto 'TRIP:1'. No sample data exists to settle it.
open_items.proposed_default: Build as mapped and emit a diagnostic counting distinct policies per TRIP: key; a count above 1 falsifies the fallback before any load.

open_items.summary_note: 22 rows anchor HUB_FINANCIAL_TRANSACTION with resolved_key.expression empty - 6 target and 16 augmentation - all currency and exchange-rate columns on two pivot views. The gate reports 6; its resolved_key_expression_missing check only inspects mapped target rows, so the 16 augmentation rows are invisible to every published count including the tier census and the CSV.
open_items.proposed_default: Leave all 22 unbuilt and list them in accepted_uncovered.txt with 'no transaction identifier exists in these source views'. Do NOT invent a key. Tell the mapper the gate under-counts by 16.

open_items.summary_note: 277 augmentation rows declare multi_active with NO child key in either form - not components, not a rendering - across the 43 proposed new satellites (SAT_QUOTE_COVERAGE_LINE 44, SAT_RISK_TRAVEL_COVER_TERMS 22, SAT_RISK_TRAVEL_TRIP_ITINERARY 20 ...). They carry a child key NAME such as 'Coverage Reference + Risk Reference' and no legs. Unchanged by this re-issue and unmentioned in the note.
open_items.proposed_default: Build them single-active in the augmented track, since a multi-active satellite with no discriminator IS single-active, and list all 277 with their proposed child key names in the handback.

open_items.summary_note: 11 SAT_POLICY_DOCUMENT_DISPATCH rows keep SERIAL_NO - a positional ordinal - as their SOLE child-key leg. The re-issue adds child_key_stability declaring it a source gap but leaves the key unchanged. A dispatch line inserted or removed renumbers the rest and re-attaches their history.
open_items.proposed_default: Build as mapped with the declaration surfaced in BUILD_STATUS.json. If the source confirms POD_NUMBER is stable and populated, one edit re-keys all 11.

open_items.summary_note: The FOREIGN_KEY round-trip to the root business number is UNPROVEN; 00_tables_index.json still carries sample_data_available=false and an empty sample_data_files map. The mapper states 733 rows depend on it; the measured exposure is 875 (863 spine occurrences use FOREIGN_KEY as the join column).
open_items.proposed_default: Build the ladder as mapped and emit a per-view diagnostic counting distinct root business numbers reached per FOREIGN_KEY value; any count above 1 falsifies it before any load.

open_items.summary_note: Is POL_RISK_ID globally unique or policy-scoped? 210 HUB_RISK_OBJECT key rows carry the qualified <root>#POL_RISK_ID form. Unchanged by this re-issue.
open_items.proposed_default: Build the qualified form per the mapper's ruling that splitting is recoverable and merging is not; isolate the qualifier so dropping it is one edit.

open_items.summary_note: HUB_RISK_OBJECT carries 'RISK:' on 215 key rows and 'TRIP:' on 12, and BOTH write SAT_RISK_PERSON_TRAVEL (RISK 54, TRIP 12). Verified identical before and after the re-issue.
open_items.proposed_default: Build both namespaces; emit the split count into BUILD_STATUS.json so two populations are visible rather than silent.

open_items.summary_note: OPUS puts premium, net premium, loading, discount, commission and cess on SAT_FINTXN_*; Maximus keeps them on SAT_POLICY_* / SAT_QUOTE_*. Verified UNCHANGED by this re-issue: the monetary home census is identical row for row across both snapshots, so no re-homing happened.
open_items.proposed_default: ACCEPT the Maximus homes. The claim that these views carry no financial-transaction identifier is confirmed by the 22 empty-expression HUB_FINANCIAL_TRANSACTION rows; moving would fabricate a key.

open_items.summary_note: One mapped row - ENDORSEMENT_TYPE on a POLICY_PROPERTY pivot view - targets multi-active SAT_POLICY_ENDORSEMENT with neither components nor a rendering. It remains the gate's single child_key_resolved warn.
open_items.proposed_default: Leave unbuilt; accepted_uncovered with the mapper's own declared-source-gap reason.

open_items.summary_note: The round-1 handoff's 'OPUS has no quote branch at all' is false and KEY_FUNCTIONS.md section 10 now corrects it in writing. travel_dv_dbt builds hub_quote.sql with natural key 'HUB_QUOTE|' || (quote_no) plus SAT_QUOTE_HEADER. Maximus has 357 HUB_QUOTE key rows.
open_items.proposed_default: Match OPUS's HUB_QUOTE rendering exactly so the two feeds share one quote population. Do not re-litigate the 20 attribute placements in this build.

open_items.summary_note: HUB_DOCUMENT keys DOCUMENT_ID as 'DOC:' || X on 2 quote-branch rows and bare on 20 document-detail rows. One document identifier, two hub rows. Same defect class as the HUB_ORG_UNIT fix, pre-existing, unswept.
open_items.proposed_default: Build the BARE form on all 22 (the 20-row majority), and record that 2 rows were de-prefixed on a builder decision. Splitting is recoverable and merging is not - but here the 2 rows are the minority AND the 'DOC:' space has no other member, so merging into the majority is the lower-risk direction. Overrule in one line if the quote-branch DOCUMENT_ID is a different population.

open_items.summary_note: BRANCH_CODE, LOCATION_CODE and STORED_COMPANY_CODE all key HUB_ORG_UNIT with no prefix, so equal values from different code systems merge.
open_items.proposed_default: Prefix each with its own namespace ('BRANCH:', 'LOC:', 'COMPANY:') at build time and declare it. Splitting is recoverable; the current merge is not.

open_items.summary_note: One HUB_ORG_UNIT row keys on a source column named HUB_LOCATION under a prefix 'ORGHUB:' used nowhere else.
open_items.proposed_default: Build it as written and flag it in the handback. Do not merge it into 'ORGUNIT:' - if it really is a location, merging would be unrecoverable.

open_items.summary_note: 7 of 16 hub-key/link-leg disagreements are value-changing, including HUB_CLAIM on CLAIM_RESERVE (key walks FOREIGN_KEY, leg walks PARENT_KEY_HASH) and an orphan 'EMP:' || BAGIC_RM_ECODE leg no hub key ever creates.
open_items.proposed_default: Emit the HUB key expression for the leg in every case, so a leg can never disagree with its hub by construction. Report the orphan EMP: leg rather than inventing a hub row for it.

open_items.summary_note: 51 of 91 LNK legs are positional and name no hub, so the leg-equals-hub-key property cannot be checked for them from the map alone.
open_items.proposed_default: Resolve positional legs against the link definition in data_7.js at spec time and assert the property there. If a link leg order cannot be resolved, do not build that link.

open_items.summary_note: resolved_key.degenerate_value holds an English sentence on all 2344 rows.
open_items.proposed_default: Treat the field as prose and derive the guard operand from the expression. Ask the mapper to rename it degenerate_value_note or restore a value.

undetermined.what: Whether the CSV's degenerate values were produced by an evaluator with a defined semantics at all
undetermined.why: Its results match neither ANSI (which gives NULL everywhere) nor a consistent non-ANSI concat (which would give 'RISK:#', not 'RISK:'), and it renders its two non-NULL classes with different quoting.
undetermined.consequence: The CSV can be used as an inventory of WHICH keys could degenerate, but its VALUES must not be turned into SQL predicates.

undetermined.what: Whether PARENT_KEY_HASH on a pivot view joins to the view's own base node or to that node's parent
undetermined.why: Source fact, no sample data anywhere in this run (sample_data_available=false, independently confirmed).
undetermined.consequence: Up to 1464 spine slots resolve to the wrong first hop; the loser mints a second hub population that reads downstream as sparse source data.

undetermined.what: Whether TRIP_NO and BILL_NO are per-parent ordinals or business identifiers
undetermined.why: Both match the ordinal shape by name; no sample data exists to test cardinality per parent.
undetermined.consequence: TRIP_NO reaches 12 HUB_RISK_OBJECT keys as a fallback operand and BILL_NO reaches 29 child-key legs. If either is an ordinal, that key merges unrelated parents or renumbers under insert.

undetermined.what: Whether the mapper's '8 exact attribute collisions' names a population I have not constructed
undetermined.why: Neither scoping I can build reproduces it (2 against the 12 SAT_AUG_* payloads, 240 against all 45 OPUS satellites).
undetermined.consequence: If the 8 is a third population, up to 6 concepts may be unaligned and invisible to both counts.

undetermined.why: No sample data in the run; 875 spine occurrences depend on it.
undetermined.consequence: If it does not hold, every tier2/tier3 key built on it resolves to the wrong parent - detectable only by a diagnostic query against real data.

undetermined.what: Whether SAT_PARTY_DIGITAL_IDENTITY's constant 'GH_TYPE_OF_USER' child key is intended as the instance name or is a placeholder
undetermined.why: Its leg_backing is column_as_instance - a kind that is supposed to vary per source column - yet it renders as one literal on both views, and only 1 row exists per view so nothing collides yet.
undetermined.consequence: A second digital-identity column on either view collapses onto the existing row silently.

undetermined.what: whether the quote-branch DOCUMENT_ID and the document-detail DOCUMENT_ID are the same population
undetermined.why: This run has NO sample data anywhere (00_tables_index.json: sample_data_available=false). The prefix split can be seen but not adjudicated.
undetermined.consequence: If they are the same population, the current map splits one document into two hub rows. If they are different, merging them would be unrecoverable. The proposed default merges, which is the direction that is wrong if the source says they differ.

undetermined.what: whether BRANCH_CODE, LOCATION_CODE and STORED_COMPANY_CODE share a value space
undetermined.why: No sample data; the three columns live on three different pivots.
undetermined.consequence: If they overlap, HUB_ORG_UNIT already merges unrelated org units today and the merge is not recoverable after load.

undetermined.what: whether the 51 positional LNK legs agree with their hubs
undetermined.why: A positional leg carries no hub name and this stage does not read data_7.js link definitions.
undetermined.consequence: More than half the link surface is unverified for the property that silently produces empty joins.

undetermined.why: Unchanged and still unproven - 733 rows depend on it and there is no sample data. It is now also implicated in the HUB_CLAIM leg/key divergence on CLAIM_RESERVE.
undetermined.consequence: If it does not hold, 863 spine occurrences keyed on FOREIGN_KEY are wrong AND one link joins to nothing.
